CustomField.description: This field is checked based on the logged-in user if they are allowed to pick up the case from the Queue
CustomField.formula:
IF( /*NON HOBART*/ OR( ISPICKVAL(Contact.Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c, "Platinum One"), ISPICKVAL(Contact.Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c, "Chairman's Lounge Platinum One"), ISPICKVAL(Contact.Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c, "Chairmans Lounge Platinum One"), Contact.SSU__c = TRUE, ISBLANK(ContactId) ) && $UserRole.Name != 'QF-QDC-OM-HBA-TL-USR' && $UserRole.Name != 'QF-QDC-OM-HBA-TL' && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Qantas Host Call")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Qantas Host Always Call"))
, TRUE, /*HOBART*/ IF( AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Contact.Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c, "Platinum One")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Contact.Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c, "Chairman's Lounge Platinum One")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Contact.Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c, "Chairmans Lounge Platinum One")), Contact.SSU__c = FALSE, NOT(ISBLANK(ContactId)), OR($UserRole.Name = 'QF-QDC-OM-HBA-TL-USR',$UserRole.Name = 'QF-QDC-OM-HBA-TL')) || AND(OR($UserRole.Name = 'QF-QDC-OM-HBA-TL-USR',$UserRole.Name = 'QF-QDC-OM-HBA-TL'), OR(TEXT(Type)='Qantas Host Call', TEXT(Type)='Qantas Host Always Call')), TRUE, FALSE ) )
CustomField.label: QCC Is Visible on Queue
